notes: LIKEs p.SearchName. The CASE ladder classifies each person: Salesperson > Employee > Customer(primary contact) > Supplier(primary) > Supplier(alternate) > NULL. COALESCE company: customer name, else supplier name, else 'WWI'. Seed persons 1..6 map one-to-one onto the six arms.

cases.name: all-six-ladder
cases.why: Empty needle matches all six people -> every arm of the CASE ladder observed in one result, ordered by FullName (Amy, Ben, Cara, Dan, Eve, Fay). Person 6 (Fay) has NULL Relationship (final CASE falls through) and Company 'WWI' (COALESCE fallback).

cases.name: salesperson-arm
cases.why: 'Amy' -> person 1, IsSalesperson=1 -> Relationship 'Salesperson', company COALESCEs to 'WWI'.

cases.name: customer-contact-arm
cases.why: 'Cara' -> person 3, not sales/employee but is a customer primary contact -> Relationship 'Customer', Company = customer name.

cases.name: supplier-alternate-arm
cases.why: 'Eve' -> person 5, matches only via a supplier's AlternateContactPersonID (the sa arm) -> Relationship 'Supplier', Company = supplier name. The narrowest CASE arm.

cases.name: unlinked-null-relationship
cases.why: 'Fay' -> person 6, no relationship at all -> Relationship NULL (FOR JSON omits the key) and Company 'WWI'. The fall-through arm.

cases.name: top-2-pagination
cases.why: Empty needle matches six but TOP(2) returns the first two by FullName (Amy, Ben).
